caption:
Koko spent the whole day at a theme park, then wandered the markets. By home time, the feet and back feel heavy.

On long walking days, regular short breaks often help more than pushing on. Comfy, worn-in shoes and a sit-down about once an hour can make a real difference to how you feel that evening.

Hybi's plan: worn-in shoes, a 5-minute sit roughly every hour, calf stretches on breaks, and an easy stroll and rest in the evening.

Leg numbness, one leg swollen and sore, or no change after two weeks is worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio
